gaps.sentence: The museum's ___ (EXHIBIT) of Egyptian art opens on Friday.
gaps.explanation: 'An exhibition' = a public display of art; 'an exhibit' is a single item.

gaps.sentence: He is one of the most ___ (SUCCESS) businessmen in the region.
We've received your ___ (REQUEST) for a refund.
Rising sea levels ___ (THREAT) the very existence of the island.
gaps.explanation: A main verb is needed after the plural subject: threaten.

gaps.sentence: The programme aims at the ___ (EDUCATE) of young farmers.
The ___ (DECIDE) to close the factory was announced yesterday.
The team's ___ (LOSE) came as a shock to the fans.
gaps.explanation: 'Their loss' — the noun for a defeat or disappearance.

gaps.sentence: They searched the area ___ (SYSTEM) for clues.
